en.name: Paul III
en.summary: The Farnese pope who convened the Council of Trent and formally approved the newly founded Jesuit order.
en.body: Alessandro Farnese launched the Catholic Church's institutional response to the Reformation, opening the Council of Trent in 1545 to define doctrine and reform discipline, and approving Ignatius of Loyola's Society of Jesus in 1540, an order that would become central to Counter-Reformation education and missionary work. He also commissioned Michelangelo's Last Judgment for the Sistine Chapel, even as his own reign was marked by the same nepotism common to his Renaissance predecessors.
